text: add a "consolidate" GetPromptRequestSchema that helps looking at all ideas and finds duplicates or creates connections where ideas are related
description: can be executed multiple times. Does not reduce information. Just consolidates and connects ideas.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A recurring embedding powered workflow can keep the graph coherent while reserving ambiguous or consequential judgments for the user.
The session starter can invoke or complement the existing consolidate_ideas prompt when related ideas, duplicates, or missing connections are found.

status.comment: The old consolidate_ideas prompt no longer existed in prompts.ts. f81854ed re-adds it as the MCP prompt `consolidate` (projectPath, optional focus subtree, writeBack). Steps: health (check/fix_consistency, graph_hygiene with megaParentThreshold 8), duplicates (find_duplicate_ideas, checked against structure, never merged by the agent), structure (group crowded parents by topic keeping hypotheses, suggest_reparents, parent the floating ideas), status (reconcile_status to review/partially, collapse candidates, archive cancelled/failed, missing reflections). Merge/delete/cancel/implemented/conflict resolution stay human decisions; without writeBack it only proposes. Tests: prompts.test.ts 11/11.
